entries.title: Release / prove-off discipline
entries.summary: Canonical staged release workflow proven on Windows/SDL after the v0.66.7.6-v0.66.7.8 cycle exposed packaging, parser/strict-mode, identity, discovery-performance, run-finalization and UI-lifecycle defects.

article.discovery: A long Windows prove-off showed that candidate quality must be validated as an end-to-end release process, not as isolated source edits. Failures included omitted local config continuity, accidental SDL bundling, strict-mode validator behavior, an unparsed PowerShell brace defect, stale build identity, unbounded run/snapshot discovery, repeated per-command bundle compression, incidental transient runs and a UI ticker overwriting completion state.
article.significance: These failures consumed development time without advancing game fidelity. Encoding the lessons as release contracts and cheap gates reduces the chance of repeating the same class of failure and keeps Full Regression as the final proof rather than the first diagnostic tool.

entries.title: TC0100SCN vertical scroll sign and neutral BG offsets
entries.summary: RC2.3 controlled Stage 1 evidence proved the native BG/TEXT source-Y calculation inverted the TC0100SCN control-word sign. RC2.4 corrects the source coordinate and removes historical BG presentation-offset compensation.
entries.details: At frame 2065 the Stage 1 control words are CTRL3=CTRL4=0x01E0. The old renderer converted that to -480 and subtracted it again. A controlled -64 presentation proxy moved both dark and pale building planes from the lower road/foreground to the skyline. For visible-top hardware Y 16, the corrected formula resolves source Y 40; this is exactly the old formula with the -64 proxy and matches the TC0100SCN negative-scroll convention used by MAME. TEXT shares the same corrected Y helper for non-zero CTRL5 cases.

article.discovery: At frame 2065 the Stage 1 control words are CTRL3=CTRL4=0x01E0. The old renderer converted that to -480 and subtracted it again. A controlled -64 presentation proxy moved both dark and pale building planes from the lower road/foreground to the skyline. For visible-top hardware Y 16, the corrected formula resolves source Y 40; this is exactly the old formula with the -64 proxy and matches the TC0100SCN negative-scroll convention used by MAME. TEXT shares the same corrected Y helper for non-zero CTRL5 cases.
article.significance: Removes historical presentation compensation and aligns source-Y semantics with evidence/reference behavior.
method: Used deterministic frame-2065 A/B offset proxy and source/control-register evidence.

entries.title: Sprite 4bpp bitplane significance
entries.summary: RC2.5 Map-405 causal evidence proves the sprite decoder used the correct physical plane addresses but reversed their 4bpp significance. Physical planes 0,1,2,3 must contribute pen bits 3,2,1,0. RC2.6 centralizes that mapping in the shared live/export decoder.

evidence.caption: RC2.5 frame-2352 causal simulation: Map 405 cloud family after MAME-consistent pen selection.
Isolated Map-405 slot 41 showing coherent cloud shading under the causal simulation.
Evidence identity, palette intervention, full 4-bit mapping and regression contract.

article.discovery: The Chase H.Q. native sprite decoder had the correct physical plane addresses but assigned their significance backwards: plane 0 was treated as the LSB. A controlled RC2.5 Map-405 palette intervention produced the exact artwork expected if the four-bit pen were reversed, without touching sprite geometry, priority or ownership.
article.significance: Sprite colour errors can be corrected at the source decode contract rather than by palette substitution or compositor compensation. Sharing the corrected decoder also keeps live rendering, map inspection and forensic exports on one pen interpretation.
method: Fork the deterministic frame-2352 timeline to live state without changing sprite geometry or priority.
Recolour only the currently decoded Map-405 pens using palette entries selected by the MAME-consistent 4-bit reversal mapping.
Capture a structured layered/per-sprite snapshot and inspect the cloud family plus reconstruction metadata.
Implement the proven significance in one shared low-level decoder and exhaustively test all 16 physical-plane masks.

entries.title: Target health / damage counter
entries.summary: CPU-A 0x1002AE is the Stage 1 special target remaining-hit counter. Genuine damage at PC 0xA112 decrements it; FFFF is the terminal sentinel and PC 0xA118 enters the real defeat path.

entries.title: One-hit Target Kill
entries.summary: Experimental special-target cheat that arms 0x1002AE to zero immediately before authentic PC 0xA112, preserving the game's genuine 0000->FFFF terminal decrement and PC 0xA118 defeat path.
